title: Chris Dixon: Stablecoins, Startups, and the Crypto Stack

reader_summary.headline: What if crypto isn't just a speculative asset class, but the next foundational layer of the internet?
reader_summary.overview: What if crypto isn't just a speculative asset class, but the next foundational layer of the internet? Today, we have Chris Dixon, founding partner of A16Z Crypto and one of the earliest investors in the space. He backed Coinbase before crypto was cool and he spent the last decade not just investing in, but actively shaping the future of decentralized technology.

key_points.text: In this conversation, Chris lays out a vision for crypto that goes far beyond price charts and hype cycles.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this conversation, Chris lays out a vision for crypto that goes far beyond price charts and hype cycles.

key_points.text: He talks about stable coins as internet native money, blockchains as global financial rails, and how programmability, not just low fees.
key_points.evidence_quote: He talks about stable coins as internet native money, blockchains as global financial rails, and how programmability, not just low fees, is the real unlock.

key_points.text: Chris also gives a candid look at the evolving regulatory landscape and why crypto still feels unexplored despite massive potential.
key_points.evidence_quote: Chris also gives a candid look at the evolving regulatory landscape and why crypto still feels unexplored despite massive potential.

key_points.text: This episode is about long-term thinking, technical optimism, and building the infrastructure for a more open internet.
key_points.evidence_quote: This episode is about long-term thinking, technical optimism, and building the infrastructure for a more open internet.

thesis: The episode argues that stablecoins and blockchains function as a global, over-the-top financial network that is low-fee, credibly neutral, and programmable, effectively replacing the current fragmented system of 195 countries with distinct banking infrastructures. This infrastructure enables new economic models, such as machine-to-machine payments for AI agents and programmable reputation systems to prevent invoice fraud, positioning crypto as a foundational layer for the internet rather than merely a speculative asset class.
